Exact.Original:
This is a farm that has been recently abandoned.

It may still contain useful supplies, and can be investigated by an [EXPLORER].
Exact.Translation:
这是一座最近被遗弃的农场。

其中可能仍有有用的物资，可由[EXPLORER]调查。

Exact.Original: Herds of [DEER] can be [Harvested|HARVEST] for [MEAT] by a [HUNTER], or for [PARCHMENT] or [CLOTH] by a [TRAPPER].[BLANK-LINE]Note that unlike other kinds of [Animals|ANIMAL] Deer cannot be added to your [Stockpile|STOCKPILE] by [Constructing|CONSTRUCT] a [Pasture|PASTURE] on them.[BLANK-LINE]This is a particularly large herd!
Exact.Translation: 一群[DEER]可被[采收|HARVEST]，获得[MEAT]；由[HUNTER]负责。还可获得[PARCHMENT]或[CLOTH]，由[TRAPPER]负责。[BLANK-LINE]请注意，与其他[动物|ANIMAL]不同，鹿不能加入[储备|STOCKPILE]；即使[建造|CONSTRUCT][牧场|PASTURE]也不行。[BLANK-LINE]这是一大群鹿！

Exact.Original: Berry Patches can be [Harvested|HARVEST] by a [GATHERER] to [Produce|PRODUCE] [FRUIT].
Exact.Translation: 浆果丛可被[采收|HARVEST]，由[GATHERER]进行，以[产出|PRODUCE][FRUIT]。

Exact.Original: Seeing this on a [Tile|TILE] means there's a [Mineral|MINERAL] there, but you don't know what kind yet.[BLANK-LINE]Once [Identified|UNIDENTIFIED] by a [DIGGER] or [SURVEYOR] you will be able to [Harvest|HARVEST] [Resources|RESOURCE] from it.
Exact.Translation: 在[地块|TILE]上看到这个标记，表示那里有一处[矿物|MINERAL]，但你还不知道具体种类。[BLANK-LINE][鉴定|UNIDENTIFIED]由[DIGGER]或[SURVEYOR]完成后，即可[采收|HARVEST][资源|RESOURCE]。

Exact.Original: Seeing this on a [Tile|TILE] means there's a [Herd of Animals|ANIMAL] there, but you don't know what kind yet.[BLANK-LINE]Once [Identified|UNIDENTIFIED] by a [HUNTER], [TRAPPER], or [SURVEYOR] you will be able to [Harvest|HARVEST] [Resources|RESOURCE] from it.

Exact.Original: Seeing this on a [Tile|TILE] means there's a useful [Plant|PLANT] there, but you don't know what kind yet.[BLANK-LINE]Once [Identified|UNIDENTIFIED] by a [GATHERER], [REAPER], or [SURVEYOR] you will be able to [Harvest|HARVEST] [Resources|RESOURCE] from it.
